extracted.name: Goat’s cheese, pear & walnut tartines
extracted.description: Top toasted sourdough with goat's cheese, honey-roasted pears and walnuts to make these tasty tartines. They take just two minutes to prep and deliver one of your 5-a-day
ingredient_lines: 4 slices good-quality bread (we used a seeded sourdough), sliced
instruction_lines: Heat a griddle pan. Cut the pears into quarters or eighths, brush with the oil and season. Cook for a few mins until charred on all sides, then drizzle with the honey.
Meanwhile, toast the bread. Spread with the goat’s cheese and top with the sticky pears, chives and walnuts. Drizzle over the balsamic vinegar and serve with some dressed salad leaves.
